# Report — Auto-close, hide-non-matching, quadrant hotkeys

**Status: implemented; CI green (build + 202/202 tests); drop shipped.** Manual Windows
verification pending.

Plan: [`20260801-180323_autoclose-quadrant.plan.qmd`](./20260801-180323_autoclose-quadrant.plan.qmd).

## What was done

1. **Auto-close** (`OverlayAutoCloseSec`, default 0 = off) — an idle timeout in
   `OverlayKeyboardHook` (a `DispatcherTimer`): the overlay closes after N sec with no
   captured key/click; any captured input resets it; skipped while suspended. Chose the
   hook because it already owns `_close`, the UI `_dispatcher`, all input, and the lifecycle.
2. **Hide non-matching** (`HideNonMatchingLabels`, default on) — a `HideInactive` DP on
   `HintCanvas` (clone of `PillOpacity`): when `!Active && HideInactive`, `RenderHint` draws
   nothing, so after the first char only matching labels show. Bound from
   `OverlayViewModel.HideInactive`. Doesn't affect zone-pick.
3. **Quadrant hotkeys** (`Ctrl+Shift+F1..F4`, startup-only) — open TL/TR/BL/BR-scoped
   overlays: a dense uniform `ZoneGridStep` grid over `ZoneService.SliceIntoZones(monitor,
   2, 2)[q]`, rebased to the monitor (full-screen, labels only in the quadrant). Reuses the
   lens machinery. `KeyListenerService` registers 4 + fires `Action<int>`;
   `ShellViewModel.OpenQuadrantOverlayAsync` builds + shows; `App.xaml.cs` unchanged.

## Verification (evidence)

- **CI** `.github/workflows/build.yml` run `30695267723` (commit `9ddac76`, windows-latest):
  Build + Test + artifact ✓. `Total tests: 202  Passed: 202`. (First run `30695217282`
  failed compile — `ShellViewModel` holds `IKeyListenerService`, so the new quadrant members
  had to be on the interface; fixed in `9ddac76`.)
- New tests: `ParseAutoCloseSec`, `ParseKeyList` theories (+11). The hook timer, renderer,
  and hotkey wiring are WPF/WinForms → manual Windows verification.
- **Shipped** to `$HAP_WIN_TEST_DIR/hap-quadrant/`; shipped `hap.exe.config` confirmed to
  carry `OverlayAutoCloseSec=0`, `HideNonMatchingLabels=true`, `QuadrantHotkeyKeys=F1,F2,F3,F4`,
  `QuadrantHotkeyModifier=Control,Shift`.
